description: Hands-on fluency with the browser's built-in DevTools: Elements, Console, Network, and a first guided debugging session combining all three.

lessons.title: Understanding Browser Rendering
lessons.description: Build a clear mental model of how the browser turns HTML and CSS into the pixels you see, from parsing to layout to painting.
lessons.originalIntent: Build a clear mental model of how the browser turns HTML and CSS into the pixels you see, from parsing to layout to painting.

lessons.title: Reading JavaScript Errors
lessons.description: Learn to read JavaScript error types, messages, and stack traces so errors become useful clues instead of scary red walls of text.
lessons.originalIntent: Learn to read JavaScript error types, messages, and stack traces so errors become useful clues instead of scary red walls of text.

lessons.title: Console Debugging
lessons.description: Use console.log, console.table, and breakpoints to inspect program state at the moment something goes wrong.
lessons.originalIntent: Use console.log, console.table, and breakpoints to inspect program state at the moment something goes wrong.

lessons.title: Debugging DOM Problems
lessons.description: Diagnose and fix common DOM failures caused by incorrect selectors, missing elements, and JavaScript running before the DOM is ready.
lessons.originalIntent: Diagnose and fix common DOM failures caused by incorrect selectors, missing elements, and JavaScript running before the DOM is ready.

lessons.title: Debug Challenge: Fix the Broken Page
lessons.description: Apply DevTools, console inspection, JavaScript debugging, and DOM diagnosis together to find and fix several problems in a deliberately broken page.
lessons.topicTitle: Debug Challenge Fix The Broken Page
lessons.originalIntent: Apply DevTools, console inspection, JavaScript debugging, and DOM diagnosis together to find and fix several problems in a deliberately broken page.
